items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: when Patsy would come in at night, I'd meet him at the door, so forth, so on.

ctx.x: Uh, reel number three with Milton Batiste on February 5th, 1997. Okay.

So, to finish telling you about Patsy, you know, uh, when Patsy would come in at night, I'd meet him at the door, so forth, so on. Say, uh, well, what you want tonight? Pat? A Patsy? And, uh, it's according to how he felt, you know, whether he wanted to be introduced that night as a man or a woman. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. So, on those nights that he wanted to be a woman, we bring you the toast of the town, Patsy Bildaya. Yeah. You know, and on the manly night, it was Pat.
